instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE through the graphical user interface to perform a linear buckling analysis of a thin plate (Variant B). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Model Definition:
Create a 3D Deformable Shell planar part. Sketch a square plate from (0, 0) to (120, 120) in the X-Y plane. Partition the plate face using two centerlines at X = 60 mm and Y = 60 mm so that the plate center and edge midpoints can be selected reliably.

Material and Section:
Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Homogeneous Shell Section with a thickness of 0.8 mm and 5 through-thickness integration points, and assign it to the entire plate.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the plate.

Analysis Step:
Create a Linear Perturbation Buckle step named Step-Buckle-B. Request 3 eigenvalues.

Discretization:
Mesh the plate with a global seed size of 8 mm. Assign S4R shell elements and generate the mesh.

Loads and Boundary Conditions:
Apply the compressive edge load of 0.9 N/mm on the two vertical edges as equivalent nodal forces after meshing. On the X = 0 edge, apply nodal forces in the positive X direction. On the X = 120 edge, apply nodal forces in the negative X direction. For each loaded edge node, calculate the nodal force as 0.9 N/mm multiplied by that node's tributary edge length. Apply U3 = 0 on all four plate edges (X = 0, X = 120, Y = 0, and Y = 120) to represent simply supported transverse conditions. At the center mesh node approximately located at (60, 60, 0), constrain U1 = U2 = 0 to suppress in-plane translational rigid-body motion. At the bottom-edge midpoint mesh node approximately located at (60, 0, 0), constrain U1 = 0 only to suppress the remaining in-plane rotational rigid-body mode.

Job Execution:
Create a job named Job-Buckle-B, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully.

Post-Processing:
Review the first buckling mode and record the first eigenvalue.

Deliverables:
Save the model database as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Buckle-B.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Buckle-B.odb.
